correctness.rationale: Every firing support is derived by induction from grain conservation and the fact that the initial broadcaster only fires once. Generalized CRT identifies exactly all tuples sharing one residue modulo g. Hence the complex splits simplicially into g joins of k discrete vertex classes plus one isolated vertex. Standard integral join homotopy gives all homology groups. At most k positive-outdegree vertices can simultaneously fire using k grains, so the homological bound is sharp. Verification over four finite fields plus complete firing-facet equality passed the reported finite cases, without treating experiments as proof.

value.rationale: The structural synchronization theorem computes an infinite family for every chip budget k≥2, every common gcd g and arbitrary coprime quotient lengths; it gives exact integral homotopy rather than only ranks. The sharp nonzero top-degree realization makes a graph-independent physical chip-budget bound optimal in all dimensions, which addresses the motivating search for high-dimensional avalanche homology. CRT creates g independent highly connected multipartite pieces, not an arbitrary isolated numeric slice. The inevitable isolated broadcaster vertex and bounded graph class are stated limitations.
